title: New Pencils
author: Robin Banerji
problems: The progression after row 8 "ones long swing in the center; end facing down to progress" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 3 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: Each looper needs a crosser on the same side line.
Row 4 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: Each looper needs a crosser on the same side line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More right catch shadow in left hand · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More right catch shadow in left hand · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
The progression after row 8 "ones long swing in the center; end facing down to progress" doesn't work out: Couple 4 is met by two couples.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A long swing is drawn as an ordinary swing.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
A swing that ends facing down the hall is drawn ending facing across; the down the hall that follows turns the lines.
